description: Marks one item on a business menu as sold out for today, or puts it back on. Anyone reading that menu afterwards sees the change, and an order for a sold-out item is refused. Needs a personal connector token (a shared token reads but changes nothing), `business`, `soldOut`, and the item as `itemId` from biz_menu or as `itemName`. Only a business the person is seated on as an owner or a manager can be changed, checked against live records on every call. An `itemName` is matched against that menu, and a name that fits more than one item is refused with the names it fits, because several items on one menu can share a word. It works in two steps: a call without `confirm` returns a preview of which item will change and what it will read as, plus a `confirmToken`, and changes nothing; a call with confirm true and that token makes the change. The token lasts two minutes, works once, and stops working if any argument changes.

business.description: Which business, by name or by id, as biz_menu returned it. Only a business the person is seated on can be changed.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which changes nothing. true, together with confirmToken, makes the change.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned. Needed when confirm is true.

itemId.description: The menu item id, as biz_menu returned it. An id matches exactly one item.

itemName.description: The item by name, when no id is at hand. Matched against that menu; a name that fits more than one item is refused with the names it fits.

requestId.description: An id for this change chosen by the caller, at least 8 characters. A repeat with the same id and the same arguments returns the first result without changing anything a second time.

soldOut.description: true to mark the item sold out for today, false to put it back on the menu.

name: biz_set_item_availability
title: Set menu item availability
